lead.title: Pakistan squad announced for England Test series
lead.summary: Pakistan have picked a 15-man group for the home Test series. Two newcomers are in the squad while a senior bowler misses out.

secondary.title: Trump waives new Russia sanctions as Ukraine ties slump
secondary.summary: President Donald Trump signed an executive order on Friday that waived sweeping US sanctions and tariffs targeting Russia’s energy revenues, marking a new low in Washington’s ties with war-torn Ukraine.

secondary.title: New AI model beats rivals on coding benchmarks
secondary.summary: A new AI model has topped several public coding tests, according to its developers. Independent researchers say more testing is needed.

secondary.title: North Korea says tested AI-assisted torpedo system
secondary.summary: North Korea has tested a “new-type” precision-guided torpedo system that uses artificial intelligence for target detection and guidance, state media reported Saturday, as the nuclear-armed country steps up weapons testing.

stories.title: Any miscalculation by adversaries will invite response beyond their ‘imagination, calculation’, warns CNSC
stories.summary: Commander National Strategic Command (CNSC) General Aamer Raza warned the country’s adversaries on Saturday that “any miscalculation will be met with a response far beyond the imagination or the calculation of the initiator”.

stories.title: Researchers warn of rising cyber attacks on hospital networks
stories.summary: A new report says hospital networks are facing more frequent cyber attacks. Experts urge basic fixes such as software updates and backups.

stories.title: When Correctness Feedback Erases Evidence: Phase-Separated Completeness Auditing in Verus
stories.summary: arXiv:2610.20676v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Correctness feedback suppresses the very evidence that specification-completeness auditing is designed to uncover: programs that satisfy a written contract but violate intended behavior.

stories.title: Anticipatory Commonsense with Moving Objects: An ASP-Based Framework for Predictive Reasoning with Interacting Trajectories
stories.summary: arXiv:2610.20867v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a general declarative framework for anticipatory reasoning about interactive motion in complex dynamic environments.

stories.title: Researchers link regular sleep to better memory in adults
stories.summary: A study of several thousand adults found that steady sleep patterns were tied to better recall. The authors say more work is needed to show cause.

stories.title: National Assembly debates new budget proposals
stories.summary: Lawmakers began debating the proposed budget, with the opposition raising concerns about taxes. A vote is expected later this week.

stories.title: Dengue cases rise as hospitals prepare for peak season
stories.summary: Health officials reported a steady rise in dengue cases. Hospitals are adding beds and urging people to remove standing water.

stories.title: Ceasefire talks resume as United Nations urges aid access
stories.summary: Negotiators returned to the table as the United Nations pressed for safe aid routes. Officials described the talks as difficult.
